Review of Accommodations Used During Testing Form Procedures
-  Current Section 504 Plan,
-  Current Individualized Education Program (IEP),
-  The form is reviewed by the team/committee during the next meeting where accommodations decisions are made
# What is the process for the completion of the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form?
# What happens with the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form after testing?
-  The original form is kept with the student’s accommodations documentation.
-  The completed form is filed with the student’s accommodations documentation.
-  A copy of the form is provided to the test administrator on testing day to be completed during the testing session. The test administrator records the following information:
-  Current Limited English Proficient (LEP) Documentation, or
-  Whether or not testing accommodations are provided to the student,

 Whether or not testing accommodations are provided to the student,

 The top and left-hand column of the form (i.e., student-identifying information, required testing accommodations, signature line) are to be completed at the student’s IEP/Section 504/LEP/TI team meeting where testing accommodations decisions are discussed and documented. All appropriate individuals must be present at this meeting.
